name: zsms-monorepo
description: ZSMS — school management SaaS by AfriTech Systems Limited
//react: Declared at the root ONLY to control npm hoisting, not because the root builds anything. apps/web needs React 19 (Next 15 App Router); apps/mobile needs exactly 18.3.1 (React Native 0.76). Two majors must coexist, so which one wins the root slot matters: `styled-jsx` is a transitive dependency of `next` that npm hoists to the root while `next` itself stays nested in apps/web. It then resolves `react` from the root. If the root holds 18.3.1, prerendering _document/_error loads a second React instance and fails with `Cannot read properties of null (reading 'useContext')`. Pinning 19 here puts web and Clerk on one instance and nests Expo's 18.3.1 under apps/mobile. Revisit when React Native supports React 19 — then the whole repo can share one version and this can go.
//overrides: @clerk/nextjs declares `next` as a peer, so npm auto-installs the newest satisfying version (16.x) at the workspace root. That put a second Next.js — and, before apps/web moved to React 19, a second React major — in the same tree as apps/web, which surfaced as a null-useContext prerender failure. Pin Clerk's peer to the version apps/web actually runs. Scoped deliberately: apps/mobile must stay on the React 18.3.1 that Expo 52 requires, so a global override is not safe here.
